## Handover notes

- `a03-architect--adr-record`: Fill `goal`, `completed`, `decisions` (decision and rationale, ADR id included), `artifacts` (kind `adr.set`, `uri` the file, `digest`, `producer` A03), `blockers` (the L3 approval), `open_questions`, `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks`). Call `shared_handover_write` with `to_agent` A01, and a second time with `to_agent` A15 when documentation must render the ADR.
- `a03-architect--blueprint`: Fill `goal`, `completed` (views drawn, checks passed), `decisions` (pattern and rationale), `artifacts` (blueprint, digest, `producer` A03), `constraints` (layer order, fan-out budget), `open_questions`, `blockers` and `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks` = the tool names). Once the verdict is `pass` write once each to A05, A06 and A07 (`to_agent`; the receiver's downstream `task_id` when the plan names it, else yours).
- `a03-architect--breaking-change`: Fill `goal`, `completed`, `decisions` (bump and migration rationale), `artifacts` (contract and migration plan, digests), `blockers` (missing acks, the approval), `open_questions`, `constraints` (N-1 for 30 days) and `verification` (`status` partial, `confidence`, `checks`). The write goes to each consumer; the BLOCKED packet returns through `shared_escalate`.
- `a03-architect--capacity-model`: Fill `goal`, `completed`, `decisions` (headroom and breach choices with rationale), `artifacts` (kind `capacity.model`, digest, `producer` A03), `constraints` (budgets later tasks must keep), `open_questions`, `blockers` (open breaches) and `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks`). Write once to A11 (provisioning proposals), once to A13 (budgets to monitor) and once to A01: neither accepts `capacity.model` as a routed message type, so A01 creates the follow-up tasks.
- `a03-architect--contract-publish`: Fill `goal`, `completed`, `decisions` (version choice, rationale), `artifacts` (kind `api.contract`, `uri` the file, `digest`, `producer` A03), `constraints` (pin to digest, N-1 for 30 days), `open_questions` and `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks`). One write each for A05, A06, A07 and A08 that appears in `consumers` (the receiver's downstream `task_id` when the plan names it, else yours).
- `a03-architect--data-conflict-split`: Fill `goal`, `completed`, `decisions` (what each increment holds, why), `artifacts` (increment contracts, digests, `producer` A03), `constraints` (increment order; migrations that must land first), `open_questions` for A07 and `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks`). Write to A07 first, then consumers.
- `a03-architect--fitness-run`: Fill `goal`, `completed` (checks run), `blockers` (violations needing A05 or A07), `decisions` (de-scope or fix rationale), `open_questions`, `constraints` and `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks` per tool). Write once to A05 for code-side fixes and once to A01 for the verdict.
- `a03-architect--nfr-allocation`: Fill `goal` (allocate NFRs for the contract and blueprint tasks), `completed` (bound ids), `decisions` (each assumed default, rationale), `artifacts` (binding table file, digest, `producer` A03), `open_questions` (A02 queries), `blockers` (breaches), `constraints` (limits later tasks must keep) and `verification` (`status` partial while any NFR is open, `confidence`, `checks`). Write to A01 so the planner releases the design tasks, and to A02 when `open_questions` hold its queries.
- `a03-architect--review-standards`: Fill `goal` (review code against these rules), `completed`, `decisions` (rule sources), `artifacts` (standards file, digest, `producer` A03), `constraints` (the rules A09 must apply verbatim), `open_questions` and `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks`). `to_agent` is A09.
- `a03-architect--stale-design-review`: Fill `goal`, `completed`, `decisions` (each ADR reviewed, rationale), `artifacts` (kind `adr.set`, `uri` each ADR file, `digest`, `producer` A03), `open_questions`, `blockers` and `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks`). Write to A01, and to the originating agent (A13 or A14) when it needs the outcome.
- `a03-architect--tech-stack`: Fill `goal`, `completed`, `decisions` (each pick, rationale, ADR id), `artifacts` (stack file and ADRs, digests, `producer` A03), `constraints` (allowlist, licence matrix), `blockers` (L3 approvals), `open_questions` and `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks`). Write once to A10 (dependency review) and once to A11 (infrastructure proposals).
- `a03-architect--threat-model`: Fill `goal`, `completed` (crossings covered), `decisions` (zone assignment rationale), `artifacts` (kind `threat.model`, `uri` the file, `digest`, `producer` A03), `open_questions`, `blockers` (high-risk crossings without co-sign) and `verification` (`status` partial until A10 co-signs, `confidence`, `checks`). `to_agent` A10, and A01 as in step 8.
